people.her: a young woman with long damp dark red hair with a strand of green river weed in it, in revealing steel plate armour: round steel pauldrons, a steel breastplate cut low, bare midriff, a short plated skirt, bare thighs and steel greaves; a sword and a round shield
people.warden: the Ford-Warden, a drowned giant nearly three times a man's height, a deep hood over his head, a ranger's leather jerkin and old mail soaked dark, a long beard heavy with river water and weed, two points of cold blue light for eyes deep under the hood, a greatsword in his right hand, and in his left fist a square cage-lamp of new black iron with a cold pale blue flame
people.ford: a shallow stony river ford at night with mist lying on the water and dark pines beyond; beside it square stone pillars, each with a cold pale blue flame burning in an iron cup on top; no bridge
people.drowned: rows of drowned dead villagers standing waist deep in the dark water, soaked, weed hanging on them, heads bowed

1.prompt: medium long shot from behind {her} at the water's edge, a square stone pillar with a cold pale blue flame in an iron cup at frame left, looking out across {ford}; {drowned} out in the river; to the right, far out in the water, one huge arm stands straight up out of the river holding a square black iron cage-lamp with a cold pale blue flame clear of the water

2.prompt: wide shot at water level across a dark misty river: {drowned}, facing away from camera in ragged rows, utterly still; at frame left a square stone pillar, and one huge arm standing up out of the water holding a cage-lamp with a cold pale blue flame

3.prompt: insert, low angle: one huge ancient armoured gauntlet, black with river slime and hung with weed, standing straight up out of dark water, its fist closed round the bail of a square cage-lamp of clean new black forged iron that hangs from it, a small cold pale blue flame inside; pines and a square stone pillar behind in the dark

4.prompt: close-up of {her} listening, very still, eyes on something out in the river at frame right; cold pale blue light on the side of her face, dark pines behind

5.prompt: low angle long shot from the water looking up at {warden} standing up out of the river, water sheeting off his hood and beard, towering against the night sky and the dark pines, the cage-lamp's cold blue flame low in his left fist

6.prompt: medium shot of {warden} wading through the ford toward camera, his greatsword across his body, the square cage-lamp with its cold pale blue flame in his left fist lighting the mist, dark pines behind

7.prompt: two-shot at a misty river ford at night showing their huge difference in size: {warden}, a giant three times her height, bending far down from above over {her}, who stands only as tall as his hip, seen from behind her as she looks up at him; he holds his square cage-lamp with its cold pale blue flame down toward her face; a square stone pillar with a cold blue flame in an iron cup at frame left

8.prompt: extreme close-up of a young woman's face, eyes, nose and lips, one side of her face lit cold pale blue by a lamp just out of frame, a tiny blue point of light reflected in each eye, wet dark red hair at the edges; her lips parted and no breath showing at all

9.prompt: low angle close-up looking up at {warden} against the night sky: his bearded face under the deep dark hood lit cold blue from below by the lamp, two points of cold blue light for eyes, his mailed shoulder and the black iron cage-lamp at frame right

10.prompt: low wide shot on the water past the dark leg of a giant at frame left, looking down a misty river: {drowned}, all turning their heads at once toward camera in a wave down the rows; dark pines and a grassy bank beyond

11.prompt: wide shot from the riverbank of the whole ford: {warden} standing in the shallows with {her} small beside him, square stone pillars with cold blue flames in iron cups, the flames all leaning toward him at once like grass in a wind; ice spreading out across the black water; dark pines

12.prompt: high angle wide shot looking down over a misty river ford at night: {warden} setting his greatsword in guard in the shallows, the square cage-lamp with its cold pale blue flame in his left fist; {her} small before him with her round shield raised on the stony crossing; a square stone pillar with a cold blue flame beside them; black water all round
